props.gloss_en: [the mishna's] 'the inner rumen' [that was perforated -- tereifa]
which is the inner rumen? sanya deivei
R' Yishmael said: the istumka of the rumen
there is a narrow place in the rumen, and I do not know which it is
the rumen has fallen into a pit
a handbreadth in the gullet next to the rumen -- that is the inner rumen
the whole rumen entire -- that is the inner rumen
and which is the outer rumen? the flesh covering most of the rumen
Rabba bar Rav Huna said: the mafrata
what is the mafrata? Rav Avya said: where the butchers open [it]
Rav Ashi: all these traditions, what [of them]? Ameimar: they all fit within Rabba bar Rav Huna's
and R' Avina's [handbreadth in the gullet] -- these certainly disagree [with the mafrata]
and the bnei maarava's [the whole rumen] -- these certainly disagree [with the mafrata]

objections.gloss_en: ודרב אסי אמר רבי יוחנן מאי אמר ליה? -- and R' Yochanan's unknown narrow place: how does it fit Rabba bar Rav Huna's?

answered_by.gloss_en: כבר פירשה רב אחא בר עוא -- Rav Acha bar Ava already explained it (= p_min_hameitzar_ulemata)

objections.gloss_en: ודרבי אבינא ודבני מערבא מאי אמר ליה? -- and R' Avina's handbreadth in the gullet and the bnei maarava's whole rumen: how do they fit?

answered_by.gloss_en: הני ודאי פליגי -- these certainly disagree (a concession narrowing 'all'; = p_pligi_tefach_baveshet, p_pligi_kol_hakares)
